name: manual_5e615e
claim: In a unified diff, a triple-plus line is a file header only outside a hunk. Inside a hunk, an added line whose text starts with two plus signs is also a triple-plus line in the patch and must be scanned as added content.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5324084599 comment 4109787024 on Perpetua-Tools PR 399. Treating every triple-plus line as a header skipped an added content line. Fixed in 0037cbe4bd5e8ba971464790fedec5e42341cbbc.
